scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Kotlin client conforming to com.google.firebase:firebase-functions via the Pyric Functions HTTP gateway and WebSocket bridge. Covers FirebaseFunctions per-app/region/customDomain singletons and KTX extensions, useEmulator, getHttpsCallable and getHttpsCallableFromUrl routing with off-machine refusal, v2 onCall and v1 https.onCall invocation, 64-bit Int64Value/UInt64Value wire serialization, automatic Auth Bearer and standard or limited-use X-Firebase-AppCheck header propagation, SSE Flow<StreamResponse> streaming, FirebaseFunctionsException error mapping, and withTimeout deadlines.
